instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium-wide, eye-level side profile shot captures an indoor studio with a red carpet and red partition screens. The man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left, facing right and leaning forward. He extends his right arm to touch the upper arm of the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2), who stands on the right facing him. The woman (R2) looks at the man with a neutral expression. The scene is lit by bright indoor lighting, emphasizing the warm wood floor and red carpet.
